name: loam-plan
description: Turn an idea or ticket into a grounded, test-first plan. Reads the repo's design → how-to → plan lattice, refuses to plan an undesigned thing, drafts a self-grounding plan, scaffolds a failing-test acceptance gate (committed red as the first commit on the branch), then auto-invokes plan-eng-review. Portable across repos via a per-repo config; proven against loam-web's docs/ + plans/ taxonomy.
